summary.en: Pre-orders opened on 25 June. The Standard Edition costs $79.99 and the digital-only Ultimate Edition $99.99; Standard owners can upgrade later. Digital copies bought before 20 November include the Vintage Vice City Pack and a month of GTA+. Boxed pre-orders include the pack.
summary.nb: Forhåndsbestillingen åpnet 25. juni. Standardutgaven koster 79,99 dollar og Ultimate Edition, som bare finnes digitalt, 99,99 dollar. Standard kan oppgraderes senere. Digitale kjøp før 20. november får Vintage Vice City Pack og én måned GTA+. Fysiske forhåndsbestillinger får pakken.

summary.en: Rockstar detailed six of the in-game radio stations, from Latin and country to metal and pop, plus on-demand podcasts. For the first time, Jason and Lucia can listen on foot through earbuds connected to their phones.

name.en: Justice Score Out 11 December, Album on Launch Day
name.nb: Justice-musikken kommer 11. desember, albumet på lanseringsdagen

summary.en: Justice composed the game's adaptive score. The 30-track Original Score comes out on 11 December on streaming services, CD and vinyl. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, with 34 original songs, comes out with the game on 19 November.

name.nb: Gratis kart over Leonida på lanseringsdagen

summary.en: On 19 November Rockstar adds a free printable cover art poster and map of Leonida to the official site. A double-sided printed version follows from the Rockstar Store shortly after launch, for $0.99 or free with any order.

summary.en: Rockstar set the release for midnight local time on 19 November, on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. In Norway that was 00:00 on Thursday 19 November.

name.en: 30 fps on Console, Ray-Traced Shadows on PS5 Pro
name.nb: 30 fps på konsoll, strålesporede skygger på PS5 Pro

summary.en: Rockstar says the game targets 30 frames per second on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. PS5 Pro adds sharper visuals through PSSR and ray-traced shadows. You can also stream it with Xbox Cloud Gaming, Xbox One included, and Remote Play works on both consoles.
summary.nb: Rockstar sier at spillet sikter mot 30 bilder i sekundet på PS5 og Xbox Series X|S. PS5 Pro gir skarpere bilde med PSSR og strålesporede skygger. Du kan også strømme spillet med Xbox Cloud Gaming, også på Xbox One, og Remote Play virker på begge konsollene.

name.en: Launch Festival in Miami on 21 November

summary.en: Rockstar and PlayStation celebrate the launch with a music festival on 21 November at Mana Wynwood in Miami. Two stages host artists from the game and its soundtrack, among them Travis Scott, Cardi B and a Justice DJ set. Tickets went through a pre-sale lottery that closed on 10 November.
summary.nb: Rockstar og PlayStation feirer lanseringen med en musikkfestival 21. november på Mana Wynwood i Miami. To scener får artister fra spillet og lydsporet, blant dem Travis Scott, Cardi B og Justice med et DJ-sett. Billettene gikk via en loddtrekning som stengte 10. november.

name.en: Settings: Eight Categories, an Accessibility Section
name.nb: Innstillinger: åtte kategorier og en del for tilgjengelighet

summary.en: The Settings menu has eight categories: Control Scheme, Controller, Gameplay, Display, UI, Camera, Audio and Account. Gameplay has an Accessibility section, and the menu also lists High-Contrast Shaders, Subtitles & Captions, Scaling & Readability and Narration.
summary.nb: Innstillingsmenyen har åtte kategorier: Control Scheme, Controller, Gameplay, Display, UI, Camera, Audio og Account. Gameplay har en egen del for tilgjengelighet (Accessibility), og menyen har også High-Contrast Shaders, Subtitles & Captions, Scaling & Readability og Narration.

name.en: BuckMe Account Limits Rise with the Story
name.nb: Grensene på BuckMe-kontoene øker med historien

summary.en: Rockstar Support says the limits on the BuckMe Checking and Family Savings accounts rise as the story progresses. A payment held up by a full Checking account goes through once the account is upgraded.
summary.nb: Rockstar Support sier at grensene på BuckMe-kontoene Checking og Family Savings øker etter hvert som du kommer videre i historien. En betaling som stopper fordi Checking-kontoen er full, går gjennom når kontoen er oppgradert.
